data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Greek name Bolanos, meaning 'swift as a bolt'. Bolan was a common name among ancient Greek warriors. In Christianity, it can symbolize courage and strength in the face of adversity. The name Bolan carries the meaning “Brave warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bolan usually hope their child will grow to embody brave warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bolan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
